overview: A family recipe archive for the Norwood family that preserves recipes, their origins, family stories, and original handwritten notes and media as preserved family tradition.
features: Browse and filter family recipes by origin, related members, era, branch, and tag
Submit recipes for Family Steward approval with the Norwood checkmark selection pattern
Link recipes to canonical Person profiles and Archive media without duplication
View recipe detail pages with ingredients, instructions, family story, and media gallery
Refined Videos & Oral History submission confirmation
